item.title: Feb. 7, 2026: Around the Region
item.description: ASHLAND The borough’s Sharon Nolter released a statement revealing the borough has increased sewage rates for 2026. Effective Jan. 1, 2026, she said, the sewage charge is $150 per quarter. The new charge will be for January, February and March and customers will receive the new bill sometime in April.
